name: Butter, salted
source: Proximate composition (per kg): water 158.7 g, protein 8.5 g, fat 811.1 g, ash 21.1 g, carbohydrate by difference 0.6 g, typical of salted butter (USDA FoodData Central pattern).
notes: Salted butter's unusually high ash is mostly added salt, not milk mineral: 90% of the ash mass is modelled as NaCl and split between Na and Cl in the exact stoichiometric ratio of that compound (Na 39.34%, Cl 60.66% by mass); the remaining 10% is milk-derived calcium and phosphorus, as in cream. Ash absorbs the rest.
